lockPolicy: Do not implement P26 or claim final reference lock before explicit user selection after viewing rendered concept screens.
provenance: Synthetic and illustrative content only. Screenshots are design sketches, not authenticated production UI or financial service results.

shared.informationArchitecture: P24 six desktop primary, five mobile tabs
contentMustShow: Budget forecast is not cash balance
Receipt evidence is not additional spending
Page titles are compact task labels
Mobile More has all secondary destinations
allColorsMustMeet: Relevant nontext graphical/controls 3:1 where WCAG requires
accessibility: Native semantic navigation in production, lab uses illustrative static elements
Keyboard and focus behavior in P27 implementation
Accessible data table companion for charts

directions.name: Ledger Atelier
directions.summary: Quiet, premium, warm finance instrument for a calm consumer experience

typography.numbers: Tabular sans with restrained Georgia large-scale numerals

directions.nav: Warm surface sidebar with one prominent active item
directions.charts: Single green actual path; copper dashed target; understated fill
directions.receipt: Original white receipt on warm-grey document stage; aligned forms
directions.mobile: Available amount first, large list rows, native camera emphasis
directions.motion: 120–180ms low-amplitude fade or translate, no parallax
risks: Too similar to conventional card-based finance products if surfaces are not simplified
Colors need rigorous contrast checks in alternate theme
distinctnessRequirements: Design hierarchy depends on aligned monetary columns

directions.name: Signal Current
directions.summary: Confident dark-first consumer finance with differentiated active signals

typography.numbers: Compact tabular sans for fast scan

directions.geometry: 11px radius; narrow accent strokes; no decorative blur
directions.nav: Deep-navy navigation and bright selected state
directions.charts: Cyan measured spend line, coral future commitments, uncluttered baseline
directions.receipt: High-contrast image review; controls share mobile card rhythm
directions.mobile: Immediate money overview; touch-sized status/attention components
directions.motion: 160–200ms gentle emphasis restricted to confirmed interactions
risks: Card-based visual hierarchy can become generic gaming/fintech UI
Too many saturated signals may distract or suggest false semantic importance
distinctnessRequirements: Do not use glowing line charts everywhere
Use one accent action per screen
Avoid neon/pill badges as default status

directions.name: Editor's Ledger
directions.summary: Swiss-inspired editorial register where exact figures and evidence are primary
directions.styleFamily: High-contrast paper, thin lines, typography-first financial editorial

typography.numbers: Tabular sans in ledger, sparing serif for primary financial totals

directions.nav: Slim editorial task index, sections revealed in context
directions.charts: Hairline grid, cobalt actual, rust target/negative; direct labels over decorative legends
directions.receipt: Two-column scanner workbench with source image and form, emphasis on proof
directions.mobile: Paper-like vertical hierarchy, consistent bottom bar and task-first controls
directions.motion: 90–150ms simple interpolation, no card hover lift
risks: Could feel austere for casual users
Dense desktop presentation needs careful mobile touch adaptation
distinctnessRequirements: Do not turn all content into cards
Use serif as accent, never at expense of numbers
Prioritize source-data tables and receipt side-by-side workbench

dimensions.name: Financial clarity
dimensions.measure: Can person distinguish posted, budget, forecast, cash and supporting evidence?

dimensions.name: Daily-task speed
dimensions.measure: Can target workflows finish with minimal switching and clear action hierarchy?

dimensions.name: Information density & hierarchy
dimensions.measure: Does desktop show useful rows and mobile avoid cramped tables?

dimensions.name: Distinctive finance identity
dimensions.measure: Does experience avoid generic SaaS dashboard, giant welcome statement, gratuitous cards?

dimensions.name: Mobile ergonomics
dimensions.measure: Does navigation remain discoverable with real one-handed touch tasks?

dimensions.name: Accessibility & responsive robustness
dimensions.measure: Contrast and dimensions meet testing targets; full screen reader/keyboard only after implementation

evaluationRubric.scoringPolicy: Qualitative criteria pending user evaluation; automated contrast checks separately recorded. Do not manufacture usability scores or claim a benchmark win.
